captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a customizable metric ruler. It features a rectangular base with a sloped front edge that facilitates easier reading and alignment of the measurement lines. Along the sloped edge, there are raised tick marks representing both millimeters and centimeters, accompanied by embossed numbers for major centimeter intervals and a 'CM' label.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable metric ruler with a sloped front edge for easy reading. The user should be able to adjust the total ruler length in centimeters, custom label text, font sizes, and text positions.
captions.factory: The script constructs the main ruler body by applying a hull operation between two translated cubes of different heights to create a sloped profile. It then uses the external 'write/Write.scad' library to render centimeter numbers and a custom label on the flat top. Finally, it uses two for-loops to generate rotated rectangular cubes representing the millimeter and centimeter tick marks along the sloped edge.
